payload.short: Table 5-1: Arabic (governing) wider than English: temporary structures/cranes and natural-ground datum
payload.text: The governing Arabic Table 5-1 (Appendix A image) and the English convenience translation (Appendix B) appear to differ in substance. (1) Scope: the Arabic note ١ covers permanent AND temporary structures, including stacks, cranes and construction equipment; the English Note (1) covers only 'all permanent structures, including stacks'. (2) Datum: the Arabic header and note ٢ measure height from natural ground level BEFORE grading and filling; the English says finished ground level AFTER grading and filling. Under ADD-03:7.2 the Arabic governs, so construction cranes would be capped at 25 m (Zone A) / 40 m (Zone B) above natural ground. This affects the crane and lifting plan and the 7.3 notification. Also, the ADD-03 cover describes Clause 5.6 as limiting 'permanent structures'. The image reading of ADD-03-p4-r1 must be approved before this is relied on.

statements.text: UNAPPROVED READING by the host model of the native image of ADD-03-p4-r1 (crop sha256 dadbcea9...; the region reading is still PENDING). The column header reads 'متر فوق منسوب الأرض الطبيعية'. Note ١ reads 'تسري هذه الحدود على جميع المنشآت الدائمة والمؤقتة، بما في ذلك المداخن والرافعات ومعدّات الإنشاء.' Note ٢ reads 'يُقاس الارتفاع من منسوب الأرض الطبيعية قبل أعمال التسوية والردم.' Rows أ (٢٥) and ب (٤٠), the 1,500 m eastern-boundary description and note ٣ (30 days before a crane is erected) agree with the English.

My proposed translation of the Arabic, which governs under ADD-03:7.2: the limits apply to permanent AND temporary structures, including stacks, cranes and construction equipment, and height is measured from NATURAL ground level BEFORE grading and filling. The English Appendix B is narrower (permanent structures only) and uses a different datum (finished ground level after grading). Because the Arabic governs, the limits bind cranes and construction equipment and use the natural-ground datum.

The bidder obligations in ADD-03:7.3 and ADD-03:7.4 are recorded as adds_obligation annotations on the new Clause 5.6 (VOL-II:5.5+ADD-03), which incorporates Table 5-1. They change no existing text, so the choice of annotation target is a judgement.

For the 7.3 deadline, the Proposal Due Date is taken as it stands at ADD-02 (26 November 2026). No provision in this batch changes it, but provisions of ADD-03 handled in other batches were not checked for a PDD change.
